acceptance.statement: Raw interaction/feedback/note/journal/insight events persist in Postgres-backed durable inbox surviving stack restart
Default worker processes inbox to generate versioned dataset records and Observe/Learn evidence handoffs
Evidence handoffs are strictly limited to Observe/Learn and cannot promote, deploy, or trade
Worker and inbox processing are idempotent by evidence_id
Backlog and DLQ are exposed, and failed items are replayable back to pending status

proof: PostgresAgoraDatasetStore connects to Postgres DB via psycopg using tables: agora_evidence_inbox, agora_dataset_records, agora_evidence_handoffs.
Tables are bootstrapped automatically with constraints and indexes surviving restarts.
AgoraDatasetStore.process_inbox worker queries pending entries in transaction block.
Generates versioned dataset records and groups them into Observe/Learn handoffs.
add_to_inbox uses INSERT OR SELECT to detect duplicates idempotently.
Subsequent requests retrieve existing records with idempotent=true flag.
get_backlog, get_dlq, and replay_dlq_item methods manage the inbox states.
